description: Add a noun-taking RESET syntax so DAMAGE can parse despite also being a synonym of DESTROY

replacements.old:
<SYNTAX RESET DAMAGE = V-RESET-DAMAGE>
<SYNTAX RESET ENVIRONMENT = V-RESET-DAMAGE>
<SYNTAX RESET BREAKAGE = V-RESET-DAMAGE>
replacements.new:
<SYNTAX RESET OBJECT (FIND RMUNGBIT) = V-RESET-DAMAGE>
<SYNTAX RESET DAMAGE = V-RESET-DAMAGE>
<SYNTAX RESET ENVIRONMENT = V-RESET-DAMAGE>
<SYNTAX RESET BREAKAGE = V-RESET-DAMAGE>
